_meta.rule_status: draft_unreviewed: rules read from the stored FTA texts (provision map v7, D3 package) by AI; no qualified reviewer has approved them

obligations.title: VAT registration (mandatory threshold)
obligations.meaning: Registering for VAT may be required when taxable supplies exceed the mandatory threshold over the last 12 months or are expected to in the next 30 days.

deadline.basis: Draft reading of the stored texts: apply within 30 days of the threshold being exceeded (not computed; unreviewed).

documents.label: Emirates ID or passport of the owner
Sales records for the last 12 months

owner_actions: Collect your last 12 months of sales records
Check the threshold on the FTA's own page before acting
professional_review: Whether supplies count towards the threshold (related parties, imports, exempt supplies)

obligations.title: VAT registration (voluntary option)
obligations.meaning: Registering voluntarily may be possible when supplies or expenses exceed the voluntary threshold.

deadline.basis: No deadline: this is an option, not a duty.

documents.label: Expense records for the last 12 months

owner_actions: Decide with an accountant whether registering voluntarily helps you
professional_review: Whether voluntary registration is worthwhile for this business

obligations.title: VAT returns and payment
obligations.meaning: A VAT-registered business may need to file returns and pay VAT for each tax period.

deadline.basis: Draft reading: by the 28th day after the end of each tax period (not computed; unreviewed).

documents.label: Sales tax invoices for the period

professional_review: The tax period assigned to the business

obligations.title: Tax invoices and record keeping (VAT)
obligations.meaning: A VAT-registered business may need to issue tax invoices and keep records for a set period.

documents.label: A place where records are kept

owner_actions: Set up an invoice template and a records folder
professional_review: Required invoice contents for your supplies

obligations.title: VAT deregistration
obligations.meaning: A registered business that stops making taxable supplies, or falls below a threshold, may need or be able to deregister.

deadline.basis: Blocked: the application deadline conflicts between official sources (20 vs 30 business days, WS-C gap G1).
